_what: The program requirements harvest pilot (Phase 1): five colleges, four program shapes at each, the same 20 programs Sam checks by hand (sheet 25, 2026-10-03). Lane: docs/reference/lanes/program-requirements-harvest.md. Plan: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/77ae8cb2-443b-45e3-b287-594c9c9b8744, section 'The pilot'.
_picked: S323 SkyHarvest, 2026-10-04. Each college's fixed use case fills one of its four slots. The other slots were picked from coci_college_programs and coci_program_courses (load 20260716-003071339fe73a7a): an ADT whose TMC lives in tmc_templates.js, with no two colleges on the same TMC; then, within each shape, the program whose listed courses carry the most CPL articulations in MAP at that college (map_college_cr_unit, matched on course code), so the units-saved question has something to answer. A certificate's slot prefers one whose listed units exceed the top of its award's unit range, which means a choose block must exist.
_closed_list: Not stored here. The runner reads each program's listed courses from coci_program_courses at run time and prints them with the page it found, so a session takes them from the job log byte for byte rather than retyping them.

_shapes.adt: An ADT, to test the TMC template mapping
_shapes.degree_list: An A.S. or A.A. with a choose-from-a-list block
_shapes.cert_electives: A Certificate of Achievement with an electives block
